items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I know Wynton Marsalis a little bit, I mean we’ve talked a couple of times.

ctx.x: Well when I was 19 I had an operation on it, which at the time, because I really didn’t know what was causing the problem, and I was kind of perpetuating the same bad habits, that after it healed and everything and I started playing, it started doing the same thing. So I didn’t think it was a success. But I think it had pretty much, it had taken care of the problems. So ten years later when I started playing again, which was almost totally by accident, I immediately decided well if I’m going to do this I want to…
You were able to stay in music in those ten years though?
